meta.recalibration_note: paper_realized/paper_run were computed from only ~1 month of low-volatility paper data (daily_std 1.13%, 7d_dd_p95 -4.09%), producing chronic false-positive divergence alerts on normal momentum drawdowns (e.g. the routine XLK dip) and even big UP days. Repointed both to the baseline_1y distribution (the strategy's true recent-history tail) so the scan only flags genuinely abnormal divergence. Original short-sample values kept under periods.paper_run_shortsample for reference.
